newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Red Cross saves drunk Austrians from freezing.
newsitem.headline: Red Cross saves drunk Austrians from freezing.

text.p: A pair of drunk Austrian teenagers were saved from freezing to death by a Red Cross worker who discovered the couple comatose in the snow at a ski race late on Sunday, the Red Cross said on Monday.

Gerhard Reithofer found the 16-year-old boy and 17-year-old girl lying unconscious behind a snack stand at Semmering, southwest of Vienna, where the temperature was minus 20 degrees Celsius (minus four degrees Fahrenheit).

The couple were taken to hospital and treated for mild hypothermia. Temperatures in Austria have plunged to their lowest for 30 years in the past week. A woman froze to death outside her home and a man died after falling into a stream.
